title: Expressing Origin & Spatial Belonging: The -beli Suffix

sections.title: Forming Adjectives of Neighborhood and Community Affiliation
sections.content: The ending *-beli* turns a place word into an adjective meaning 'from that place': *falu* -> *falubeli* (from the village), *város* -> *városbeli* (from the town), *hely* -> *helybeli* (local), *környék* -> *környékbeli* (from the neighbourhood). The adjective does not change: *a falubeli emberek*. Used as a noun it takes *-ek*: *a falubeliek* (the villagers).

items.spanish: A falubeli emberek mindig segítenek egymásnak.
items.english: The people from the village always help each other.

items.spanish: A helybeli piac szombaton is nyitva van.
items.english: The local market is open on Saturday too.

items.spanish: A környékbeli gyerekek a parkban játszanak.
items.english: The children of the neighbourhood play in the park.
